scope: Assay statistics, model observables and requirements for quantitative comparison.

records.source: Cui et al. 2021, Figure 3f and GEO GSE145923
records.source_observable: Regional MeRIP IP/input enrichment at the published NEDD4L exon-1 feature
records.source_denominator: Matched untreated regional IP/input enrichment, with replicate and normalization rules documented
records.source_exposure: Arsenic exposure in the source experiment
records.source_time: Experimental protocol with uncalibrated model time
records.model_observable: M_ned occupancy fold versus the model control
records.required_before_fitting: Verify assembly conversion and coordinate convention for NM_001144966.3, re-extract IP/input replicates, and justify the enrichment-to-occupancy mapping.

records.source_observable: Approximate maximum bar count across substitution categories in sequenced TP53 3D-PCR products
records.source_denominator: Maximum category count in the comparison arm. Molecule and nucleotide-opportunity denominators are unavailable.
records.source_time: Panel-specific endpoint with uncalibrated model time
records.model_observable: N, an arbitrary cumulative fixation index for a representative modeled lineage
records.required_before_fitting: Full counts, sampling opportunities, assay selection and uncertainty, matched exposure/intervention/time, and a defensible observation function connecting the selected statistic to N.

records.source_denominator: DMSO condition in the same panel
records.source_exposure: The panel does not specify arsenic exposure. The model comparison assumes an unexposed baseline.
records.model_observable: A3B in E=0 FTO-inhibition diagnostic divided by E=0 model control
records.required_before_fitting: Verify exposure background, estimate the effective activity multiplier for this dose, map experimental time, and allow an observation model capable of the measured dynamic range.

records.source: Gao et al. 2022, Figure 3E (approximately 3.3-fold from digitised chase curves)
records.source_observable: APOBEC3B actinomycin-D chase decay response after FTO knockdown
records.source_exposure: Arsenic is not specified for this panel
records.required_before_fitting: Original chase data and uncertainty, matched background and perturbation, and a compatible occupancy-response model. Default maximum unexposed decay ratio is 2.444, below 3.3.

records.source: Zhao et al. 2024, antioxidant transcript chases
records.source_observable: Decay estimates for SOD1, SOD2, CAT, TXN and GPX1, preserving gene, stage, siRNA and replicate
records.source_denominator: Same gene and stage siControl decay estimate
records.source_time: Experimental chase hours within each exposure stage
records.model_observable: Decay of one writer-associated antioxidant aggregate
records.required_before_fitting: A justified aggregate observation function, original replicate design, stage-specific intervention effects and experimental-to-model time mapping. Genes are not interchangeable biological replicates.

records.source_observable: PRDX5 decay estimates by stage and siRNA
records.required_before_fitting: A separate PRDX5 state with the appropriate reader sign and data-supported contribution to antioxidant capacity.

records.source: Cui et al. 2021 GSE145923 and Yang et al. 2021 GSE145924, including published METTL14-DDB2-YTHDF1 functional experiments
records.source_observable: First-three-exon IP/input contrast relative to background transcripts, with independent functional repair evidence from the source study
records.source_denominator: Same feature in the matched control, with normalisation to the background median
records.source_exposure: Arsenic and METTL14 perturbation are distinct source protocols
records.source_time: Experimental protocols with uncalibrated model time
records.model_observable: M_rep occupancy and Q, a DDB2/NER translation proxy
records.required_before_fitting: Justify enrichment-to-occupancy mapping, METTL14 versus simulated METTL3 intervention mapping and any transfer to aggregate lesion repair. Cross-transcript bounds are not replicate confidence intervals or equivalence tests.

records.source_observable: NEDD4L knockdown in FTO-deleted cells and downstream phenotype
records.source_denominator: Matched source background within the factorial experiment
records.source_time: Experimental endpoint with uncalibrated model time
records.model_observable: Illustrative NEDD4L re-expression with FTO unchanged
records.required_before_fitting: Match the FTO-deleted background, NEDD4L knockdown and measured endpoint.
